questions.stem_text: What could the government do to most effectively avoid a free rider problem?

options.A: Supply public goods using tax dollars
options.B: Initiate a lottery system for the usage of public goods
options.D: Increase the prices of public goods
options.E: Allow private companies to supply public goods

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - Supply public goods using tax dollars

questions.stem_text:
If there is a monopolistically competitive industry with firms enjoying above-normal
profits, what will probably happen to costs as other firms enter the industry?

options.C: costs are not affected by entry of new firms

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: A - costs will tend to rise

questions.stem_text:
Which one of the following would be a plausible response to a finding of residual non-
normality?

options.A: Use a logarithmic functional form instead of a linear one
options.B: Add lags of the variables on the right hand side of the regression model
options.C: Estimate the model in first differenced form
options.D: Remove any large outliers from the data.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: D - Remove any large outliers from the data.

questions.stem_text: What gives rise to the so-called pecuniary economies or diseconomies of scale

options.A: Changes in the market demand and supply
options.B: Changes in the short-term operational efficiency of the company
options.C: Fluctuations in the stock market affecting the company's capital valuation
options.D: Changes in the overall economic condition
options.E: Changes in the long-run cost per unit of output due to variations in the prices of inputs

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: E - Changes in the long-run cost per unit of output due to variations in the prices of inputs
